scope: Behavioral intent frozen before implementing association; numeric geometry and Kotlin expectations will be finalized from the independent audit, before replay. This is not an unseen OCR-quality corpus.
cases: aligned-repeat
Two well-overlapping interior boxes in adjacent strips, same nonempty raw text; one association with both source IDs.
variant-conflict
Aligned boxes containing 城市稅 and 城市税; retain both raw strings, conflict, no selected correction.
clipped-full-pair
Read-edge-clipped short result overlaps a complete result; retain both and flag partial evidence.
same-text-adjacent-columns
Same label in separate side-by-side columns must not become one group.
same-text-different-rows
Identical raw text at separate page y coordinates stays separate.
same-strip
Two candidates from the same strip are not automatically deduplicated.
same-strip-ambiguity
Two candidates from one strip match one from its neighbor; ambiguous association, no agreed text.
transitive-chain
A-B and B-C edges without A-C agreement do not establish one confirmed element.
tall-over-halo
A long/tall box crossing more than the overlap extent is retained and needs review.
rotated-envelope
Overlapping axis-aligned envelopes of unsupported rotated quads cannot be called agreement.
core-center-jitter
Shifting ownership center across the core boundary never drops either original candidate.
empty-recognition
Empty raw text remains a candidate; cannot supply agreed text.
nonoverlap
Text similarity alone does not associate spatially disjoint boxes.
blank-page
A complete empty page yields no invented candidates/groups.
mixed-provenance
Capture version, page, model or planner mismatch rejects the whole request.
bad-geometry
Non-finite, degenerate, out-of-read or inconsistent local/page coordinates cannot enter accepted output.
cancel-and-incomplete
Incomplete or cancelled work publishes no groups, including late cancellation.
order-and-immutability
Input permutation leaves IDs/groups unchanged; caller mutation cannot alter accepted snapshots.
budget-boundaries
128 candidates and 8192 characters are bounded; overflow rejects the whole request.
identity
Duplicate source IDs cannot silently overwrite another candidate.
